text_en: “I loathe my life; I will give free utterance to my complaint; I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.
text_cn: 我实在厌恶我的生活，我要任意苦诉我的怨情，倾吐我心中的酸苦。

text_en: I will say to God, Do not condemn me; let me know why you contend against me.
text_cn: 我要对天主说：不要定我的罪！请告诉我：你为何与我作对？

text_en: Does it seem good to you to oppress, to despise the work of your hands and favor the schemes of the wicked?
text_cn: 你对亲手所造的，加以虐待和厌弃，却显扬恶人的计划，为你岂有好处？

text_en: Do you have eyes of flesh? Do you see as humans see?
text_cn: 你岂有肉眼，或者也像人一样观看吗？

text_en: Are your days like the days of mortals, or your years like human years,
text_cn: 你的日月岂像人的日月？你的年岁岂像人的年岁？

text_en: that you seek out my iniquity and search for my sin,
text_cn: 你竟考查我的邪恶，追究我的罪过。

text_en: although you know that I am not guilty, and there is no one to deliver out of your hand?
text_cn: 其实你知道我并没有罪过，也知道无人能拯救我脱离你的掌握。

text_en: Your hands fashioned and made me; and now you turn and destroy me.
text_cn: 你亲手形成了我，创造了我；此后你又转念想消灭我。

text_en: Remember that you fashioned me like clay; and will you turn me to dust again?
text_cn: 求你记忆：你造我时就像砖泥，难道还使我归于泥土？

text_en: Did you not pour me out like milk and curdle me like cheese?
text_cn: 你不是将我像奶倒出，使我凝结像一块奶饼？

text_en: You clothed me with skin and flesh, and knit me together with bones and sinews.
text_cn: 用皮和肉作我的衣服，用骨和筋把我全身联络起来？

text_en: You have granted me life and steadfast love, and your care has preserved my spirit.
text_cn: 是你将生命的恩惠赐给了我，细心照顾维持了我的气息。

text_en: Yet these things you hid in your heart; I know that this was your purpose.
text_cn: 这些事早已藏在你心中，我知道你久有此意：

text_en: If I sin, you watch me, and do not acquit me of my iniquity.
text_cn: 你监视我，看我是否犯罪；如果我有罪；你决不放过。

text_en: If I am wicked, woe to me! If I am righteous, I cannot lift up my head, for I am filled with disgrace and look upon my affliction.
text_cn: 我若有罪，我就有祸了！我若有义，也不敢抬头，因为我已备尝凌辱，吃尽苦头。

text_en: Bold as a lion you hunt me; you repeat your exploits against me.
text_cn: 我若抬头，你就像狮子追捕我，向我表现你的奇能，

text_en: You renew your witnesses against me, and increase your vexation toward me; you bring fresh troops against me.
text_cn: 重新袭击我，加倍对我泄怒。

text_en: “Why did you bring me forth from the womb? Would that I had died before any eye had seen me,
text_cn: 你为何叫我出离母胎？不如我那时断气，无人见我，

text_en: and were as though I had not been, carried from the womb to the grave.
text_cn: 就好像从未有过我一样，一出母胎即被送入坟墓。

text_en: Are not the days of my life few? Let me alone, that I may find a little comfort
text_cn: 我生存的日月不是很少吗？你且放开我罢！

text_en: before I go, never to return, to the land of gloom and deep darkness,
text_cn: 趁我去而不返，未到冥暗死影之地，

text_en: the land of gloom and chaos, where light is like darkness. ”
text_cn: 即光明也是黑暗之地以前，让我自在一下罢！
